summary: Parker-Hannifin filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting two senior note offerings. On September 8, 2026, the company priced $2.4 billion of U.S. dollar-denominated senior notes in four tranches: $525 million due 2028 at 4.750%, $500 million due 2029 at 4.875%, $750 million due 2031 at 5.125%, and $625 million due 2033 at 5.300%. A concurrent euro-denominated offering was also underwritten. Notes were sold through Barclays, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley under an existing indenture, with interest payable semi-annually. Closing is expected on or about September 14, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no equity terms or arbitrage angle apply.
